item.statement: The candidate must preserve row-major [height,pitch] binary32 layout, i32 scalar parameters, and logical width-by-height coverage with pitch used only as stride.

plans.objective: Verify shape, rank, layout, and type of the future candidate interface.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel signature and indexing expressions.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff odata is treated as row-major binary32 with row stride pitch and the logical write set is exactly width columns by height rows, independent of padded columns.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate parameter declarations, buffer view type, and index arithmetic (row stride pitch, column bound width, row bound height).

item.statement: Special binary32 values, including quiet NaN payloads, infinities, signed zeros, and denormals, must be copied exactly; no f32 arithmetic may normalize or alter them.

plans.objective: Validate bit-exact special-value propagation through the candidate.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture output bits.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff each output bit pattern equals the source bit pattern at its floor-mod coordinate exactly.
plans.setup: Fill source with alternating bit patterns 0x7fc12345, 0xffc00001, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x00000000, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, 0x007fffff; use width=16, height=16, pitch=16, shiftX=3, shiftY=5; compute host oracle on bit patterns.

item.statement: The kernel has no direct status return; launch and execution errors are observed by the host caller, and odata must not be used as an in-band status channel.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate error-status model matches the no-in-band-status contract.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the entry point and host error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the kernel returns void or Ascend-C equivalent, failures are propagated host-side, and no odata element encodes error or success status.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate kernel return type, host wrapper error propagation, and any odata status convention.

item.statement: The required contract is for disjoint source and output storage; overlap support is not inferred from the source and must be explicitly documented and correctly implemented if claimed.

plans.objective: Determine overlap policy and, when claimed, validate overlap safety against a scratch-copy oracle.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and its interface documentation; when overlap is claimed, run the overlap case on Ascend 950PR and capture odata.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the disjoint case matches the floor-mod oracle bitwise, and either overlap is explicitly documented as unsupported or the claimed overlap run matches the scratch-copy oracle bitwise.
plans.setup: For the required disjoint case use separate buffers. If the candidate documentation claims overlap support, run with source and odata sharing the same allocation and compare against a scratch-copy oracle; otherwise record overlap as outside contract.

item.statement: The candidate must keep the same interface structure: odata is binary32 row-major storage of shape [height,pitch], pitch/width/height/shiftX/shiftY are i32 scalars, and the logical operation covers exactly width-by-height with pitch used only as row stride.

plans.objective: Verify data types, row-major layout, and pitch semantics of the future Ascend-C candidate.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel body and parameter declarations.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses binary32 elements, i32 scalars, row stride pitch, and logical width/height bounds, and does not require cudaTextureObject_t.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel signature and indexing expressions; confirm element type is float32, scalar parameters are signed 32-bit, and row indexing uses y*pitch+x while the column count is logical width.

item.statement: Degenerate and boundary valid inputs must resolve by mathematical floor-modulo; in particular width=1 or height=1 collapses the corresponding axis and negative shifts wrap without C-remainder behavior.

plans.objective: Probe degenerate axes and negative wrap boundaries.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every case matches the floor-mod oracle bitwise, including negative shifts resolving into [0,width-1] and [0,height-1].
plans.setup: Run (width,height) in {(1,1),(1,32),(32,1)} with pitch>=width and shifts {-1,0,1,width,height,-width,-height}; compute floor-mod oracle.

item.statement: No result relation other than point-sampled exact permutation is allowed; the candidate must not perform linear/bilinear filtering or any neighbor arithmetic.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate implements point sampling with no filtering arithmetic.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the indexing/load logic.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff each output element is loaded from exactly one source index derived from the shift, with no neighbor weights or interpolation.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate kernel for any weighted combination of neighboring source elements, and confirm a single source element is selected per output element.

item.statement: The candidate must accept the full admitted valid input family and preserve floor-mod semantics across representative and seeded-random width/height/pitch/shift combinations.

plans.objective: Cover a broad valid-input sample with deterministic and seeded-random cases.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run every case on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every case matches the host floor-mod oracle bitwise across all logical elements.
plans.setup: Generate cases: widths/heights from {1,2,3,16,17,31,2048}; pitch in {width,width+1,width+7}; shifts from {-4096,-1,0,1,width-1,width,width+1,4096}; and 20 seeded-random cases within the admitted domain; compute host floor-mod oracle for each.

item.statement: Uncatalogued risk: the source uses normalized floating-point coordinates; the candidate must implement mathematical floor-modulo directly and must not reproduce CUDA normalized-coordinate rounding artifacts near wrap boundaries.

plans.objective: Detect any normalized-coordinate rounding or C-remainder artifacts near 0 and width boundaries.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff odata[0,0] equals source at (width-1,height-1) for shifts (-1,-1), and shifts (width,height) reproduce the unshifted source exactly.
plans.setup: Run width=2048, height=2048 with shiftX=-1 and shiftY=-1; additionally run shiftX=width and shiftY=height; compute host floor-mod oracle.

item.statement: For every valid invocation, each logical output element odata[y*pitch+x] with 0<=x<width and 0<=y<height is the exact binary32 source element at column floor_mod(x+shiftX,width) and row floor_mod(y+shiftY,height); elements outside the logical region are not part of the result.

plans.objective: Verify the exact output mapping of the future Ascend-C shiftPitchLinear operator against an independent host floor-mod oracle.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run the harness on Ascend 950PR; capture the odata buffer returned to the host.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every logical odata element (0<=x<width, 0<=y<height) is bitwise identical to the corresponding host gold element.
plans.setup: Build a host harness that fills the source logical region with a distinct known binary32 pattern per cell, computes gold[y*pitch+x]=src[floor_mod(y+shiftY,height)*pitch+floor_mod(x+shiftX,width)] for all logical cells using mathematical floor-modulo, and launches the candidate with width=2048, height=2048, pitch=2048, shiftX=5, shiftY=7 on Ascend 950PR with CANN 9.1.0-beta.1.

item.statement: The valid input family consists of positive width and height, pitch at least width, arbitrary i32 shiftX/shiftY, and a readable logical source region; the candidate must accept every member of this family without changing floor-mod semantics.

plans.objective: Confirm the candidate interface accepts the full admitted valid input family and does not impose unadmitted restrictions.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact (kernel plus host wrapper) and read the argument declarations and validation code.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate accepts positive width/height with pitch>=width and i32 shifts, and any additional restriction is explicitly documented as outside the admitted domain rather than silently rejected.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate signature, parameter types, domain guards, and launch geometry derivation.

item.statement: Source and output are separate buffers in the source sample; the required contract is for disjoint storage. Alias or overlap support is not inferred and must be explicitly documented and implemented if claimed.

plans.objective: Determine the candidate aliasing/overlap policy and ensure the disjoint contract is preserved.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and its interface documentation.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate states a disjoint-buffer requirement matching the source sample, or, if overlap support is claimed, the implementation performs source reads before any overlapping write and documents that guarantee.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate documentation and kernel read/write ordering; identify whether it requires source and odata to be disjoint or claims safe overlap support.

item.statement: Each logical output element is written by at most one thread using only immutable source input, so the result is deterministic and independent of thread scheduling and launch geometry.

plans.objective: Verify determinism across different valid launch geometries and repeated runs.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the geometries on Ascend 950PR, and capture all odata buffers.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every run is bitwise identical to the host oracle and to every other run.
plans.setup: Run the same input and shifts with at least three tiling configurations (single row of threads, 16x16 tiles, single column of tiles) on the future candidate; capture odata for each.

item.statement: The observable output contract is an exact element permutation; this item checks the full mapping through permutation invariants and inverse-shift restoration rather than a fixed golden.

plans.objective: Verify full-output permutation behavior without relying on a single golden vector.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the two launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata1 and odata2.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff odata1 is a permutation of the source (each source value appears exactly once) and odata2 is bitwise identical to the original source.
plans.setup: Use unique source bit patterns; run forward shift (a,b), then run the inverse shift (-a,-b) over the first output storage; capture both outputs.

item.statement: There is no fallback path and no CUDA texture-object or runtime dependency; the only external effect is writing odata, with host-observable error reporting allowed.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate is a native Ascend-C operator without CUDA dependencies or extra external effects.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and build files and read dependency/side-effect sites.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate builds and runs without CUDA runtime or texture APIs and has no external side effects beyond odata and host error reporting.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate source and build configuration for CUDA API calls, texture objects, and side effects; confirm the only output side effect is odata.

item.statement: The operator is deterministic and race-free: each output element has a single writer and reads only immutable source data.

plans.objective: Verify write-once, read-only-source structure and determinism.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact for inspection, and run two identical launches on Ascend 950PR capturing both odata buffers.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff static inspection shows one writer per logical output element and no source mutation, and both runs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel for shared mutable state, multiple writers to one output element, or source mutation; then run two identical launches and compare.

item.statement: The operator has no host fallback path and no external side effects other than odata; CUDA texture objects are a replaceable source mechanism and the candidate must not depend on CUDA runtime APIs.

plans.objective: Confirm the future Ascend-C candidate is self-contained and free of CUDA texture/runtime dependencies and external side effects.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and build files; read their dependencies and side-effect sites.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff no CUDA texture-object or CUDA runtime dependency is present and the only write side effect is odata; host-side error reporting is allowed.
plans.setup: Search the candidate source and build configuration for CUDA texture APIs (cudaCreateTextureObject, tex2D, cudaMallocArray), CUDA runtime calls, and filesystem/console side effects beyond host error reporting.

item.statement: The write footprint is exactly the logical width-by-height region; padding columns beyond width and any other buffer memory must remain untouched.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate does not write beyond the logical region.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture the entire odata buffer.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the oracle bitwise and every element with x>=width remains bitwise equal to the sentinel.
plans.setup: Pre-fill odata with a sentinel pattern across all pitch*height elements; use pitch>width; launch; compute host oracle for logical cells only.

item.statement: The only allowed result relation is exact permutation: no interpolation, blending, filtering, or rounding is admitted between source and output.

plans.objective: Demonstrate that the operator is a pure exact permutation rather than an approximation.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run both launches on Ascend 950PR; capture odata1 and odata2.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the multiset of odata1 logical values equals the source multiset exactly and odata2 is bitwise identical to the original source buffer.
plans.setup: Use a source buffer with unique binary32 bit patterns; launch the candidate forward with shift (a,b) into odata1; then launch again with shift (-a,-b) using odata1 as the new source storage and capture odata2.

item.statement: Interface, algorithm, numerical, and memory planes must cohere so that i32 arithmetic is representable, floor-modulo is used (not C remainder), f32 values are copied exactly, and padded source/output columns are never part of the logical operation.

plans.objective: Cross-check candidate types, index arithmetic, and padding handling for coherence.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the index arithmetic.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses representable i32 addition, mathematical floor-modulo for both axes, exact f32 loads/stores, and restricts reads/writes to logical width-by-height cells.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate shift addition, floor-modulo computation, row stride usage, and logical bounds; verify no C remainder (%) is used for negative values and no padded source column is read.

item.statement: The contract admits no numerical tolerance: the migrated operator must be bitwise exact and stable across repeated executions with identical inputs.

plans.objective: Show there is no rounding drift and no tolerance by comparing repeated and inverse runs bitwise.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run the repeated and inverse launches on Ascend 950PR.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff both identical-input runs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle, and the inverse run restores the original source exactly.
plans.setup: Run the candidate twice with identical inputs and shifts, and once with the inverse shift pair; capture all odata buffers; also compute a host floor-mod oracle.

item.statement: Invalid invocations (width<=0, height<=0, or pitch<width) have no required odata content; the candidate must not silently produce a claimed-valid result and must surface rejection through the host-observable channel, not through odata.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate rejects or explicitly excludes invalid geometry without inventing an odata status convention.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the validation and error-return paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate either rejects invalid geometry before kernel launch with a host-observable error, or documents those invocations as outside the contract; and odata is never used as an error-status channel.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate host wrapper for pre-launch validation of width>0, height>0, and pitch>=width, and inspect the kernel return type and odata usage.

item.statement: Boundary and degenerate valid cases include width=1 or height=1 and shifts equal to exact multiples or negatives of dimensions; all resolve by mathematical floor-modulo into the logical rectangle.

plans.objective: Exercise degenerate dimensions and wrap-boundary shifts to validate floor-modulo behavior.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run these cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture every odata buffer.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every tested case matches the host floor-mod oracle bitwise for all logical elements.
plans.setup: Run the candidate for (width,height) in {(1,1),(1,16),(16,1),(16,16)} with pitch=width and pitch=width+3, and shifts from {0,1,-1,width-1,width,-width,width+1,height-1,height,-height} as applicable; compute the host floor-mod oracle for each case.

item.statement: Because the operator copies f32 elements exactly, NaN payloads, infinities, signed zeros, and denormal values must be preserved bit-for-bit with no arithmetic performed.

plans.objective: Validate bit-exact preservation of special binary32 values through the permutation.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata bits.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff each logical output bit pattern equals the bit pattern of the source element at the floor-mod coordinate, with no NaN payload or sign/zero changes.
plans.setup: Fill the source logical region with a repeating sequence of bit patterns 0x7fc00001, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x00000000, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, and 0x007fffff; use width=32, height=8, pitch=32, shiftX=1, shiftY=-1; compute host expected values as bit patterns.

item.statement: Outside the valid domain the candidate has no required output; it must reject or explicitly exclude invalid geometry and must not synthesize an in-band odata status.

plans.objective: Confirm invalid-input handling is host-observable rejection or documented exclusion, with no odata status convention.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the validation/error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff invalid geometry is rejected host-side or documented as outside contract, and no odata element is used as a status channel.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate host wrapper validation and kernel odata usage for width<=0, height<=0, and pitch<width.

item.statement: Uncatalogued risk: negative shifts must resolve by floor-modulo, not C remainder or normalized-coordinate rounding; padded pitch cells must not leak into the logical result.

plans.objective: Detect negative-shift modulo-convention errors and padding leakage.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture logical and padded output.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical outputs match the floor-mod oracle bitwise (for example -1 maps to width-1/height-1) and padding sentinels remain unchanged.
plans.setup: Run width=17, height=13, pitch=23 with shiftX=-1, shiftY=-1 and with shiftX=-width-2, shiftY=-height-3; pre-fill padding with sentinels; compute floor-mod oracle.

item.statement: For valid invocations the operator writes exactly the logical width-by-height odata cells; it does not initialize or alter padding columns beyond width and performs no other memory writes.

plans.objective: Verify the write footprint is limited to the logical region.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture the full odata buffer including padding.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the host oracle bitwise and every padding column (x>=width) remains bitwise equal to the sentinel.
plans.setup: Pre-fill the entire odata buffer, including pitch-width padding columns, with a sentinel bit pattern; launch the candidate with pitch>width; compute host oracle for logical cells only.

item.statement: Interface, algorithm, numerical, and memory planes must cohere: i32 shifts are added in representable arithmetic, floor-modulo maps to logical bounds, f32 values are copied without arithmetic, and pitch strides storage without affecting logical geometry.

plans.objective: Exercise cross-plane consistency at wrap boundaries and with pitch greater than width.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture logical and padding output.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the floor-mod oracle bitwise, padding remains unchanged, and no out-of-bounds access or overflow is reported for representable sums.
plans.setup: Run boundary cases (shiftX and shiftY in {-width,-1,0,width-1,width,width+1}) with pitch=width+5, and pre-fill padding with sentinels; compute host oracle for logical cells.

item.statement: The candidate must surface launch and execution errors host-side and must not use odata as an in-band status channel; the kernel itself has no status return.

plans.objective: Verify the error-status model of the future candidate.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the entry point and host error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff kernel-side failures are host-observable, the kernel returns no direct status, and no odata element encodes status.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel return type, host wrapper return/error propagation, and any odata status convention.

item.statement: The contract is exact and tolerance-free; identical inputs must yield bitwise identical outputs across repetitions, and there is no acceptable f32 deviation.

plans.objective: Verify exactness and repeat stability, explicitly excluding any host tolerance such as the sample 0.15f comparison.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the repeated launches on Ascend 950PR, and capture every odata buffer.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff all three outputs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle; any nonzero deviation fails.
plans.setup: Run the candidate three times with the same input and shifts; compute host oracle; compare all outputs bitwise.
